research(v6): checkpoint E9 through Seal 07 scope

Retain accumulated E9 implementation, tests, scientific records, manifests, qualification evidence, attempt history and documentation. Seal 06 remains PASS WITH FINDINGS; Seal 07 scope is frozen and implementation has not begun. Preserve exact sealed CRLF bytes with narrow attributes; keep private evidence, review archives and transient outputs outside Git.
checkpoint_context.reason: Deliberate checkpoint addition of narrow '-text' attributes so Git preserves the exact CRLF working-tree bytes that E9 scientific records and Seal 06 bind by raw hash (the four E9 evidence, planning-ruling and recovery-test paths and the five Seal-06 CRLF tracked files); the in-file comments state this purpose. A repository byte-preservation change, not a change to any scientific input, implementation or qualification byte.
